answer: One covert probe tracks the zephyr above each agent’s ridge; at 0.4-second intervals the node emits a beacon pulse the network’s satellites triangulate. An attacker trying to fake an extra identity must supply a robotic drone that fires a fresh beacon pulse every cycle, draining 0.003 watt-hours per head—each drone battery dies after 18 pulses, making farms run out of juice before Sybils scale.
